source_conflicts.issue: Description says sections I–V; attached six-page PDF has I–IV and no section V. Five figures are present.
source_conflicts.handling: Count only I–IV as actually read. Do not invent Section V. Mark full available-source coverage, not proof of missing-section nonexistence.

source_conflicts.issue: SI calls the STO characterization substrate single-crystal (001) TiO2, whereas main specifies TiO2-terminated SrTiO3 and the SI itself repeatedly says SrTiO3 varactors.
source_conflicts.handling: Use main explicit material STO with TiO2 termination; preserve SI wording as unresolved probable shorthand/typo. Never substitute bulk TiO2.

source_conflicts.issue: Caption describes panels a,b,c and a frequency-trace panel, but actual figure has a data/model heatmap (a) and capacitance/resistance graph (b); no panel c or frequency-trace panel is visible.
source_conflicts.handling: Anchor data by actual pixels. Do not assert the missing trace experiment was observed.

source_conflicts.issue: Methods calls approximately 3 kHz a DC filter time constant; earlier main text correctly uses filter bandwidth.
source_conflicts.handling: Keep approximately 3 kHz bandwidth as reported; do not silently convert it to a time constant without a filter model.

source_conflicts.issue: SQD inductor is reported as L=320 nH while the stated model code is Coilcraft 0805CS-331. Manufacturer nominal value not independently verified in this packet.
source_conflicts.handling: Keep source-reported 320 nH, model ID and unresolved component nominal separately. Do not quietly replace with 330 nH.

source_conflicts.issue: Fabrication opening generically says degenerately doped substrates but later specifies low-resistivity SQD and high-resistivity/undoped DQD substrates.
source_conflicts.handling: Maintain separate material lineages; DQD must not inherit SQD degenerately doped substrate.

source_conflicts.issue: Effective Rf includes losses of varactor, inductor and board; room-temperature datasheet losses did not fit millikelvin measurements.
source_conflicts.handling: Do not grade Rf as intrinsic dielectric loss. Track model-fit uncertainty and phase-regime constraints.

source_conflicts.issue: 225 ns spin-state readout is inferred using an assumed capacitance, not an experimental demonstrated spin readout; predicted gigahertz and lower-loss improvements are prospective.
source_conflicts.handling: Mark them theory/future-only and exclude from empirical task-success criteria.

source_conflicts.issue: KTO heatmap frequency axis prints 215 at both the bottom and next tick.
source_conflicts.handling: Do not recover a precise lower frequency boundary from this duplicated label; retain qualitative reported matching/frequency response only.
